dedupe_keys.name: dice jl climate economy model implementations

description: DICE.jl is a Julia collection of published DICE climate-economy model versions. It represents interactions among economic output, emissions, global temperature and climate damage, then solves policy or emissions scenarios with JuMP and a nonlinear optimiser. Users set model parameters, emissions or policy constraints and the version to reproduce; outputs include time paths of climate and economic variables. Geographic scope is global, with aggregate sectors, not a specific infrastructure network. MIT source and documentation are public, and the README describes Ipopt as an open solver option. It also warns that some MUMPS configurations make scenarios brittle and that a separate HSL solver has its own academic licence. A limitation is that DICE's aggregate damages do not measure losses at an individual utility, road or building. The model can supply broad climate-economy context for long-run infrastructure pathways. The related catalogue IPCC AR6 scenarios database is a separate scenario collection. No solver, package or model results were downloaded.
inputs: Climate-economy parameters and policy or emissions assumptions
